text:
Aaron (Marketing): Quick drop — I put together a one-page draft that ties secure deploy modes + SLA language + benchmark highlights for field use. Need fast passes from product, eng, security, and sales. Goal: publish as a field-ready brief and thread it into the webinar invite.

Anna M (Product): Thanks — will skim. Key ask: call out Dedicated vs Hosted behavior and the rollback/canary line so customers know the rollout options. Keep the intro <3 lines.

Sam (Eng): Quick note on benchmarks: current p99 for short-chat is ~120ms on dedicated; long contexts push higher. I'll confirm numbers by EOD. Also add a short sentence about automatic KV caching + fallback to smaller model when capacity constrained.

Lina - Sales: Need a short procurement-friendly blurb about reserved capacity commitments and pricing trigger points. Also include 1 sentence for CISO: "data remains in customer VPC or on-prem; optional KMS/HSM integration."

Raj (Security): Add SOC2/ISO bullets, encryption in transit+at-rest, and audit-log availability. One-paragraph about private control plane + audit trails would calm buyers.

Becky (Field Ops): For inbound routing, add recommended tagging: use "deploy_mode", "SLA_tier", and "region" fields in leads. Suggest default routing: enterprise_sales -> solutions_engineer -> platform_team. Webinar CTA should link to a short checklist and a 15-min discovery slot.

Aaron (Marketing): Nice — I'll incorporate those. Two quick asks before I lock: (1) approve benchmark phrasing (we'll use qualifiers), (2) pick 2 webinar co-hosts.

Sam (Eng): Approve qualifiers. Use "typical p99 on Dedicated (short seq): ~120ms; typical token cost range: $0.0003–$0.0008 depending on quantization/profile".

Anna M (Product): I'll co-host the webinar and do the runtime + rollout demo.

Lina - Sales: I'll co-host and bring a buyer POV. Also flag: field needs a short PDF for procurement (one-liner + bullets).

Raj (Security): Approve security bullets. Add: customers can opt-in to key rotations + HSM-managed keys.

Becky (Field Ops): Routing approved. I'll wire the lead scoring tags into the SDR queue.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: lock marketing brief if no objections by 18:00 PT.

Aaron (Marketing): Thanks — final items below. Subject line candidates (pick one):
```
- "Secure Inference for Enterprises: SLA-backed, VPC-ready deployments"
- "Reduce latency, control cost: Dedicated & Private inference for production"
- "Run LLMs behind your firewall — predictable performance, enterprise SLAs"
```

Aaron (Marketing): I'll update the draft with these inputs, attach a two-slide procurement summary, and schedule the webinar for Apr 8. If anyone sees an emergency wording issue ping me. :thumbsup:
